reason: Owner decision 2026-09-26: the Diablo II codecs (character model, DC6, DT1) are dropped from the port and the project. In MK2 they were metadata-only planned codecs — manifests with no implementation ("Detection, decoding, rendering, and export are not implemented") — so there is no behaviour to carry, and MK3 has no Diablo II code or manifest.

rows.where: MK2 declared a metadata-only planned codec with no source files; MK3 has no Diablo II code to remove
